messages:
Leah: FYI — Parcelly (enterprise) says their free-trial credits never appeared in their production workspace after SSO onboarding. They see the credits on a workspace named `parcelly-staging-1` instead and are blocked on integration tests. Can someone triage?

Alex: ok — can you paste the two org IDs + a sample user email and the promo code? I can check grants and billing ledger.

Leah: sure. org_prod: `org_0a1b2c3d`
org_shadow: `org_1a2b3c4d`
user: amelia@parcelly.com
promo: `PARCELLY-TRIAL-2026`

Alex: quick peek at billing: promo applied to org_1a2b3c4d at 2026-03-10 per billing service.

Sanjay: this looks like a JIT SSO provisioning duplicate — sso-sync logs show an assertion came with external_id `parcelly-idp-42` but mapped to a new org due to missing mapping. tagging @Taylor for DB-safe fix.

Taylor: I can move the grant but need the exact grant id. Run this query: 
```
SELECT id, org_id, code, amount FROM promo_grants WHERE code='PARCELLY-TRIAL-2026';
```

Alex: ran it — result: `pg_99321` -> org_id=`org_1a2b3c4d`, amount=1500.00

Taylor: plan: create an audit row then update the grant row to point at org_0a1b2c3d. Backup + update in a single transactional window. Migration snippet: 
```sql
-- backup row into audit table
INSERT INTO promo_grant_audit (grant_id, old_org, new_org, changed_by, changed_at) VALUES ('pg_99321','org_1a2b3c4d','org_0a1b2c3d','taylor', now());
UPDATE promo_grants SET org_id='org_0a1b2c3d' WHERE id='pg_99321';
```
I'll run in ~30m.

Leah: customer asked how fast the UI will reflect credits after the move.

Taylor: balances are cached for ~5 minutes. After DB update we must invalidate cache: `POST /internal/cache/invalidate?org=org_0a1b2c3d` — that forces immediate visibility.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance window confirmed for 2026-03-15 21:00 UTC — allowed for manual DB ops. :white_check_mark:

Alex: note — we keep audit row for rollback. I'll draft the CS note to Parcelly and let them know ETA (~10min after op).

Taylor: Patch applied at 1951234675. promo_grants `pg_99321` updated to org_0a1b2c3d. Cache invalidated. Billing ledger now shows promo tied to org_0a1b2c3d and balance +$1500. Verified with `SELECT balance FROM org_balances WHERE org_id='org_0a1b2c3d';` -> 1500.00

Leah: Parcelly confirmed credits are visible and their integration tests proceed. They ran smoke tests ok.

Leah: follow-up: creating infra ticket to prevent JIT duplicates — adding dedupe on external_id during SSO provisioning (INFR-789).

Taylor: opened PR to add external_id canonicalization + guard: https://github.com/redwood/infr/pull/412 — awaiting review.

Leah: closing this thread. Will add short postmortem note and CS summary for the account record. Thanks everyone! :tada:
